usage: A common noun for a small body of still water; use it when talking about a real pond in a park, village, or countryside setting.
It is usually a general, countable noun in Cantonese, so it can take numbers or classifiers when you refer to one pond or more than one pond.
Natural with words about animals and plants, especially when describing fish, lotus, frogs, ducks, or water scenery around the pond.
Neutral and everyday in tone; it is not a slang word and is easy to use in simple descriptions of places, homes, gardens, or nature scenes.
